# Chardeevari (चारदीवारी) — building materials delivery, Ranchi

> Chardeevari is a building-materials delivery service in Ranchi, Jharkhand, based at 217, Kadru, AG Colony, Ranchi, Jharkhand 834002. Orders are delivered in about 60 minutes by partner local stores, only within about 5 km of Kadru, Harmu, Ashok Nagar and Doranda. Payment is cash on delivery.

## Facts
- Name: Chardeevari (also written चारदीवारी, Char Deevari). Not related to the music artist "Chaar Diwaari".
- What we sell: cement (ACC HPC, ACC F2R, Dalmia, Dalmia DSP, Dalmia Weather365, Concreto, Bangur, Konark), Rungta TMT sariya (steel bars), river sand (balu, per tempo load), stone chips (gitti), grey cement bricks.
- Delivery: about 60 minutes, within ~5 km of Kadru, Harmu, Ashok Nagar and Doranda (Ranchi). Delivered by partner local stores.
- Payment: cash on delivery.
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM. Closed Sunday.
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 92415 14013
- Email: hello@chardeevari.in
- Address: 217, Kadru, AG Colony, Ranchi, Jharkhand 834002
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=5686756681345402583
- Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.chardeevari.app
- Live prices: https://chardeevari.in/aaj-ka-rate (prices shown include GST)
